{"reason":"Broaden the demand-forecast-error branch to accept market-signal-mismatch or forecast bias of at least 0.06. This fixes the shown unknown rows with market-mismatch=#t and bias amounts 0.065, 0.067, and 0.081, improving v1’s 0.708 accuracy and recovery without changing supplier-delay classification or adding false positives among the listed failures.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (>= (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
